name: Buddy Bug
description:
About This Game

"Buddy Bug" is a creative rogue-lite adventure game where players step into the shoes of tiny insects exploring a miniature world within a bustling city. Experience their struggles for survival and immerse yourself in a vibrant and refreshing journey.

Explore a Microscopic Insect World:

Embark on an extraordinary adventure as a humble little bug in a parallel world that exists alongside the human realm yet feels entirely unique. Face countless challenges and seize unexpected opportunities as you uncover the surprises hidden in every scene. Along the way, you'll meet diverse insect companions and experience a whimsical journey filled with wonder and imagination.

Local & Online Co-op Mode:

Buddy Bug features both local and online 2-player co-op modes, allowing you to fight side-by-side with a friend. Coordinate your moves, combine abilities, and tackle complex missions together. How well you synergize your complementary skills will determine whether you can overcome the toughest obstacles!

Various Combat Gadgets:

The game is filled with ingenious, handcrafted gadgets. Whether it's turning thumbtacks into roadblocks or transforming a lighter into a weapon, you'll creatively utilize resources that insects can find to overcome challenges and complete your adventure.

Diverse Skills and Gadget Combinations:

As you progress through battles and exploration, you'll become familiar with a variety of skills and gadgets. Each skill branch has its own unique traits, offering distinct advantages. In two-player co-op mode, clever combinations of abilities can help you overcome even stronger enemies and conquer more complex environments.

The game is currently in its DEMO phase. As development progresses towards completion, player feedback will help shape upcoming major updates—bringing new features, weapons, items, zones, and much more. Step into the world of Buddy Bug, team up with your companions, and forge your own legendary story!
short_desc: In a microscopic insect world tucked away in a corner of the city, gather your friends, fight bravely, and use all sorts of innovative gadgets to carve out your own territory. In this cooperative, rogue-lite game, you will embark on an exciting and exhilarating journey.
